title: a file that declares one type shows its kind beside its name, as the editor's own file decoration fed by `nvs/fileKinds`
scope:
how an editor's file list tells a class file from an interface, enum or `type` alias file,
and the seventh request of Novis's own that answers it. What shape an autoloaded file must have
stays `rule:programs/one-declaration-per-autoloaded-file`'s.
